mutation_targets.rationale: The permission matrix is the single load-bearing fact for all allow/deny cells. Clearing it removes every explicit Allowed cell assignment, so Alloy is free to populate PermMatrix.Allowed arbitrarily. The injection adds unauthenticated and non-member access to PATCH and DELETE, directly violating LeastPrivilege, AuthRequiredEverywhere, and NoInformationLeakage.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermMatrixViolation { (CallerUnauth -> OpPatchTask) in PermMatrix.Allowed  (CallerNonMember -> OpDeleteTask) in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the constraint that audit entries for deleted tasks must survive. The injection creates a DeletedTask whose audit entries all reference a different task, simulating orphaned (effectively erased) audit entries for the deleted task — exactly what append-only is meant to prevent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some t: DeletedTask | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.ae_task = t }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditCreatedEntry allows tasks to exist without a 'created' audit entry. The injection forces a task that has no DescCreated audit entry at all, directly violating AuditCompleteness and FR_015_AuditPerSave.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingCreatedAudit { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.ae_task = t and ae.ae_change = DescCreated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditTeamMatchesTask removes the denormalised team-consistency requirement on audit entries. The injection places an audit entry whose ae_team differs from its ae_task's task_team, simulating a cross-team audit record leak that breaks cross-team isolation on the audit endpoint.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditTeamMismatch { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.ae_team != ae.ae_task.task_team }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditActorAttributed removes the requirement that the audit actor holds a team membership matching the recorded role. The injection creates an audit entry whose actor has no membership in the entry's team at all, simulating a misattributed or fabricated audit record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributedAudit { some ae: AuditEntry | no m: TeamMembership | m.mem_user = ae.ae_actor and m.mem_team = ae.ae_team and m.mem_role = ae.ae_actor_role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_OwnerImmutableViaMatrix removes the rule that OpPatchOwner is denied for every caller. The injection grants CallerAdmin the OpPatchOwner operation, simulating a privilege-escalation path where even admins could change task ownership — exactly what FR-006 forbids.
